req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-007 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a new unique squad_number returns 201 Created, (2) a negative/EP case confirming a duplicate squad_number returns exactly 409 Conflict with the correct detail message, (3) a boundary/STC case confirming the state transition from first-create (201) to second-create-same-number (409) is deterministic, (4) a DT case confirming a different squad_number after a 409 still succeeds with 201, and (5) a NEG case confirming the 409 detail payload is exact. All tests use pre-loaded fixture data (squad numbers 1-26 exist) and the FastAPI TestClient in-process.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99 (not in pre-loaded data)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99, and a valid UUID id
trace: R-PLAYER-007: positive path — unique squad_number must succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_boundary_first_and_last_preloaded
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 1 is the minimum pre-loaded squad number
Squad number 26 is the maximum pre-loaded squad number
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=1 (boundary minimum of pre-loaded range)
POST /players/ with squad_number=26 (boundary maximum of pre-loaded range)

POST with squad_number=26 returns HTTP 409 Conflict

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tests.name: test_post_different_squad_number_after_conflict_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=77 — expect 201 (different squad number, no conflict)
expected: Second POST returns HTTP 201 Created with squadNumber=77
trace: R-PLAYER-007: DT — duplicate squad_number -> 409; unique squad_number -> 201; both branches exercised
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_different_squad_number_after_conflict_returns_201():
    dup_payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r_dup = client.post("/players/", json=dup_payload)
    assert r_dup.status_code == 409
    assert r_dup.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

    new_payload = {
        "firstName": "New",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r_new = client.post("/players/", json=new_payload)
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    body = r_new.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert body["firstName"] == "New"

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_response_is_not_201_or_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=5 which already exists
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 409, not 200, not 201, not 422, not 500
trace: R-PLAYER-007: NEG — status_code mutation resilience; catches 409->200, 409->201, 409->422 mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_squad_number_response_is_not_201_or_200():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Vivaan",
        "lastName": "Nair",
        "squadNumber": 5,
        "position": "Central Midfield"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 422
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
